description: This file defines a base class for a WebDAV server implementation in PHP, including request handling, method dispatching, and lock management.

classes.name: HTTP_WebDAV_Server
classes.description: A base class for implementing WebDAV servers, providing request dispatching, HTTP method handling, and lock management.

methods.name: ServeRequest
methods.description: Dispatches incoming WebDAV HTTP requests to the appropriate handler methods.

methods.name: http_OPTIONS
methods.description: Handles the OPTIONS HTTP method, returning allowed methods and WebDAV compliance level.

methods.name: http_PROPFIND
methods.description: Handles the PROPFIND method, returning properties of resources.

methods.name: http_PROPPATCH
methods.description: Handles the PROPPATCH method, updating resource properties.

methods.name: http_MKCOL
methods.description: Handles the MKCOL method, creating collections.

methods.name: http_GET
methods.description: Handles the GET method, retrieving resource content.

methods.name: http_HEAD
methods.description: Handles the HEAD method, returning resource headers.

methods.name: http_PUT
methods.description: Handles the PUT method, storing resource content.

methods.name: http_DELETE
methods.description: Handles the DELETE method, deleting resources.

methods.name: http_COPY
methods.description: Handles the COPY method, copying resources.

methods.name: http_MOVE
methods.description: Handles the MOVE method, moving resources.

methods.name: http_LOCK
methods.description: Handles the LOCK method, locking resources.

methods.name: http_UNLOCK
methods.description: Handles the UNLOCK method, unlocking resources.

methods.name: _allow
methods.description: Returns a list of allowed HTTP methods based on implemented handlers.

methods.name: mkprop
methods.description: Helper to create property elements for responses.

methods.name: _check_auth
methods.description: Checks authentication if the method is implemented.

methods.name: _new_uuid
methods.description: Generates a UUID for lock tokens.

methods.name: _new_locktoken
methods.description: Creates a new opaque lock token.

methods.name: _if_header_lexer
methods.description: Lexical analysis of the If: header.

methods.name: _if_header_parser
methods.description: Parses the entire If: header into URI conditions.

methods.name: _check_if_header_conditions
methods.description: Checks if the conditions from the If: header are met.

methods.name: _check_uri_condition
methods.description: Stub for checking a single URI condition; to be overridden.

methods.name: _check_lock_status
methods.description: Checks if a resource is locked, considering lock scope.

methods.name: lockdiscovery
methods.description: Generates lock discovery XML for a resource.

methods.name: http_status
methods.description: Sets HTTP response status and mirrors it in headers.

methods.name: _urlencode
methods.description: Minimal URL encoding for special characters.

methods.name: _urldecode
methods.description: Decodes URL-encoded strings.

methods.name: _prop_encode
methods.description: Encodes property values to UTF-8 if necessary.
